title: Let a Small Model Read First: Faster Prefill for Long Interleaved Image-Text Inputs
abstract: arXiv:2611.24431v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) can answer questions about long interleaved inputs, such as documents of many pages and collections of hundreds of images, but they are slow to start: on inputs of about 100K tokens, the prefill takes most of the wait for the first output token. A common approach prunes the input by scoring its tokens with the target model itself or with a small model of the same family that first writes an answer. However, this scoring takes much of the time that pruning saves. We find that the evidence for a question lies in a few whole units (images or paragraphs), and that a small hybrid model finds them with one attention head of an early layer, even at half image resolution. Based on these findings, we propose SkimPrefill, which lets the small hybrid model read the whole input first, up to that early layer, with images at half resolution. translated_title: 让小模型先读：加速长交错图文输入的预填充
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）能够回答关于长交错输入的问题，例如多页文档或数百张图像的集合，但它们的启动速度很慢：在约100K token的输入上，预填充占据了等待第一个输出token的大部分时间。一种常见做法是通过用目标模型本身或同系列中先写出答案的小模型对输入token进行评分来剪枝输入。然而，这种评分过程消耗了剪枝所节省的大部分时间。我们发现，回答问题所需的证据集中在少数完整的单元（图像或段落）中，而一个小型混合模型仅凭早期层的一个注意力头就能找到这些单元，即使在半图像分辨率下也是如此。基于这些发现，我们提出了SkimPrefill，让小型混合模型以半分辨率图像先读取整个输入直到该早期层。小型混合模型（Qwen3.5-0.8B）的大多数层以线性时间运行，因此……（原文截断）
tldr: 提出SkimPrefill方法，让小型混合模型以半分辨率快速浏览输入至早期层，仅用一个注意力头即可定位与问题相关的关键图像或段落单元，从而大幅加速长交错图文输入的预填充。
en_tdlr: SkimPrefill lets a small hybrid model skim the whole input at half image resolution up to an early layer, locating question-relevant images or paragraphs with a single attention head, thereby greatly accelerating prefill for long interleaved image-text inputs.
